title: Art. 5.5.2 — Annex 11 - Air Traffic Services, Chapter 5 - Alerting Service, 5.5 Information to the operator, 5.5.2
content: All information notified to the rescue coordination centre by an area control or flight information centre shall, whenever practicable, also be communicated, without delay, to the operator.
